components.name: Primary Button on Dark

components.name: Sign Board (arm)
components.description: Mist arrow board with ink rules; right-pointing arm.
components.css: .ds-arm { background: #9fb3bf; color: #1c2a33; padding: 11px 42px 11px 20px; width: 280px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #1c2a33, inset 0 -2px 0 #1c2a33; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 22px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 22px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-arm b { display: block; font: 700 28px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .01em; } .ds-arm span { display: block; font: 500 15px/1.3 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Service List Row
components.description: Ink-ruled service row with condensed name and arrow.
components.html: • WebdesignIhre Website, persönlich umgesetzt.
components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-list li { border-top: 2px solid #1c2a33; border-bottom: 2px solid #1c2a33; } .ds-list a { display: block; padding: 26px 56px 26px 0; color: #1c2a33; text-decoration: none; transition: padding .25s ease; } .ds-list a:hover { padding-left: 14px; } .ds-name { display: block; font: 700 40px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-text { display: block; color: #3f4e57; font: 400 17px/1.6 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a Schwarzwald-Baar hiking signpost: it points a local business owner to the next step. Flat Schiefer grounds carry Dunst arrow boards lettered in slate ink; Himmel sections give the reading rhythm in between. The world stays recognisable with all content removed: mist-blue arrow boards on a slate field.

The tone is calm and precise. Sign lettering is condensed, uppercase where it is a sign, and reading text is plain Barlow. Every board is flat, with one pointed end and a thin ink rule top and bottom; depth comes from colour blocks, not effects. There is no accent colour: the owner chose "only slate", so hierarchy comes from value and shape, never from a second hue. A person and a place come before decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Slate ground, mist signal boards, sky reading sections, slate ink; one cool blue-gray hue family throughout.
Arrow-shaped boards (clip-path point) with 2–3px ink rules inside top and bottom edges.
Barlow Condensed for sign lettering and headings, Barlow for reading.
Flat at rest; motion is small fades and 6–14px slides, all disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: Slate, mist and sky are values of one hue family; no yellow, green, red or indigo joins them. Emphasis comes from the dark/light flip, board shape and size.

rules.name: The Mist Board Rule
rules.body: Mist appears on boards, the closing board and small markers (dots, badge, featured border, icons). Text on mist is always slate ink, never white.

rules.name: The Button Flip Rule
rules.body: The primary button is slate with sky text on light grounds and sky with slate text on dark grounds (hero, dark sections); on the mist closing board it is slate.

rules.name: The Sign-Or-Read Rule
rules.body: Condensed face for signs and headings, Barlow for anything read in sentences. Headings use text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Flat-Board Rule
rules.body: Boards carry no drop shadows; their edge is the ink rule drawn as an inset shadow.

dos: Do keep the palette to the one blue-gray family: slate, mist, sky, paper and their tinted grays.
Do put mist only on arrow boards, the closing board and small markers, with slate ink text.
Do draw boards flat: one pointed end, 2–3px ink rules top and bottom.
Do flip the primary button: slate on light, sky on dark.
Do use Barlow Condensed for headings and sign text, Barlow for sentences.
Do keep the "GDS." wordmark exactly as is (Manrope 800, indigo gradient, #7a7ae0 dot, "Webdesign & SEO" subline).
Do keep 44px minimum touch height and visible 3px focus outlines; wrap all motion in reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do use en dashes and formal German "Sie".
donts: Don't introduce an accent colour; the owner chose "only slate".
Don't use gradient text, glow, particle or canvas effects, or navy and indigo outside the wordmark.
Don't add drop shadows to boards or cards.
Don't invent photos, references, numbers or testimonials.
Don't use typewriter or counting animations.
